svg.title: Who has evidence for immunotherapy: a three-box map plus the Taiwan NHI box
svg.desc: Schematic three-box map of immunotherapy in oesophageal cancer plus a Taiwan NHI box. Box 1, residual tumour after surgery (tick): CheckMate 577 (n=794, residual disease after preoperative chemoradiotherapy and R0 resection, SCC plus adenocarcinoma), one year of postoperative nivolumab, median disease-free survival 22.4 vs 11.0 months, HR 0.69; overall survival not statistically significant (as cited); treatment-related grade 3/4 adverse events 13% vs 6%; JES CQ9 strong recommendation A. Box 2, first-line metastatic (tick; the higher the PD-L1, the larger the benefit): CheckMate 648 (all SCC, n=970), TPS 1% or more, nivolumab plus chemotherapy overall survival 15.4 vs 9.1 months, HR 0.54; all randomised 13.2 vs 10.7 months, HR 0.74; KEYNOTE-590 (SCC plus adenocarcinoma, n=749), SCC with CPS 10 or more 13.9 vs 8.8 months, HR 0.57; all patients 5-year survival 10.6% vs 3.0%; grade 3/4 treatment-related events 47%/32%/36% across the 648 arms and 72% vs 68% in 590. Box 3, immunotherapy added to definitive chemoradiotherapy (cross): KEYNOTE-975 (pembrolizumab, n=703) did not meet its EFS primary endpoint; RATIONALE-311 (tislelizumab, Chinese SCC, n=370) PFS HR 0.92, OS HR 1.10; SKYSCRAPER-07 (consolidation atezolizumab with or without tiragolumab, SCC, n=760) missed its primary endpoint with PFS HR 0.82, while the atezolizumab-alone arm had a descriptive overall survival HR 0.69; KUNLUN data expected 2027, ESCORT-CRT not read out. Taiwan NHI box (Drug Reimbursement Regulations 9.69, 2026-08-21 version): second-line nivolumab monotherapy from 1 April 2024; first-line nivolumab with fluoropyrimidine and cisplatin or oxaliplatin from 1 February 2026; both require PD-L1 TC 1% or more, ECOG 1 or less, prior approval, 12 weeks per application and at most 2 years; no clause for postoperative adjuvant use; pembrolizumab not yet reimbursed for this indication.

g.text: Each box has its own trials and entry conditions: residual disease after
surgery, first-line metastatic (read PD-L1), and immunotherapy added to
definitive chemoradiotherapy. Directions are written as found — negative
The bottom box is the current NHI text (consolidated version dated
2026-08-21): two clauses only, both nivolumab, both requiring TC≧1%.

Both first- and second-line columns of the biomarker table read 'not yet
Four Chinese first-line SCC trials (camrelizumab, toripalimab, sintilimab, tislelizumab)
all showed longer survival, but their availability and reimbursement in Taiwan were not
verified and are not drawn. CheckMate 577's SCC subgroup and KEYNOTE-590's SCC
proportion are not in the abstracts and are not drawn.
Schematic, redrawn from Kelly 2021 (CheckMate 577), Verhoeven 2026 (OS as cited), Doki
2022 and Kato 2026 (CheckMate 648), Sun 2021 and Metges 2025 (KEYNOTE-590), Merck's
2026 Q1 8-K (KEYNOTE-975), ClinicalTrials.gov posted results for RATIONALE-311,
SKYSCRAPER-07 (Ann Oncol 2026), the KUNLUN and ESCORT-CRT registry records, the
ASCO 2023/2026 guidelines, JES 2022 and section 9 of the Taiwan NHI Drug
Reimbursement Regulations (2026-08-21 version) | cohorts, designs and endpoints differ —
numbers in different boxes are not directly comparable
